scope: Independent visual inspection of actual application captures produced by other team QA; not a claim to have operated all 43 doors or all gameplay services.
acceptedObservations: The three domestic interior arrangements have clean native alpha, separate furniture and a common direction of visible upper surfaces.
The wall bays remain upright; low sidewall cutaways and the floor provide a readable room depth without vertically squashing furniture.
Painted furniture and actors have plausible relative sizes; their visible feet contact the floor in the reviewed compositions.
The exterior doors are visibly larger than an adult actor and retain the measured openings; house A contact at the threshold is readable.
The native shuttle and pad are correctly distinguished as an upright projected object and a ground surface; the inspected port view has no opaque image-background rectangle.
The desktop element codex explicitly identifies project-original content and shows the common geometric registry; this does not establish canonical fidelity of invented architecture.

findings.observation: The old perspective panorama and legacy orbital text remain visible between paved polygons and at the port border. Abrupt triangular pavement edges interrupt the common ground plane.
findings.requestedCorrection: A continuous native ground base under the walkable city, with the old panorama removed from that plane; any distant backdrop must not masquerade as traversable ground.

findings.observation: The south exit label is clipped into a narrow gold line with fragments of letters.
findings.requestedCorrection: Keep the physical exit marker at the threshold but move the readable label outside the clipping floor plane or give it sufficient display bounds.

findings.observation: The proximity toast overlaps the open codex on small screens; the landscape capture does not show the upper dialog controls.
findings.requestedCorrection: Verify modal isolation, close-button accessibility and viewport scroll position in the final responsive run.

qaRunDistinction.firstInteriorRun: interiors-v64/failure.json contains an armory dialogue timeout and is not a complete PASS.
qaRunDistinction.secondInteriorRun: interiors-v64-final was still running at this review; its partial progress includes successful armory and mausoleum dialogues but is not substituted for its eventual final report.
qaRunDistinction.codexRun: codex/report.json reports three responsive functional checks PASS; this independent visual review records additional issues rather than changing that report.

limits: This review covers selected visible compositions, not every exterior district or every depth-sorting state.
The native asset contract and standalone compositions passed separately; final application visual acceptance awaits the listed renderer corrections and new captures.
Publication and production verification remain separate gates.

followupReview.reviewer: Homeworld renderer owner, following independent initial review

findings.observation: Continuous dark native ground base covers gaps; no old panoramic architecture remains. Pad has no flat orbital label; orbital transport is explained at the console. Paved polygon edges remain visible as street boundaries, with no claim that the entire dark background is walkable.
South exit label is fully visible above its marker on mobile and desktop. Native wall scale and actor/furniture ground contacts are preserved.

No proximity toast covers the codex panel; close controls are visible. Global topbar no longer covers Homeworld header. Portrait filters have separate rows. Landscape remains compact and needs inner scrolling.

followupReview.scope: Selected native compositions visually rechecked and six adult/four youth physical visits passed on local compiled4184. All43 geometric paths pass separately. Public deployment remains a separate gate.

compiledVerification.observation: Final compiled captures confirm continuous terrain, no projected orbital pad label, visible exit text, compact in-game header and all mobile movement controls within viewport. NPC/player/furniture ground alignment retained in reviewed public rooms. Dynamic trophy collection is empty in the synthetic adult fixture; this recipe does not visually certify owned trophy displays.
